label: Other IMAP server
help: Use the IMAP and SMTP settings supplied by your email host or administrator. Both connections require TLS or STARTTLS.

label: Gmail / Google Workspace
help: Use your full account email and an app password with 2-Step Verification. Some managed or protected accounts do not allow app passwords; OAuth sign-in is not available in Cerberus yet.

label: iCloud Mail
help: Use an app-specific password and your full iCloud account email as the username for both IMAP and SMTP.

label: Outlook.com / Hotmail
help: Microsoft requires OAuth (Modern Authentication). Cerberus does not support Microsoft mailbox sign-in yet. These are the documented server settings; password login is unavailable.

label: Microsoft 365 / Exchange Online
help: Microsoft requires OAuth and your organization must allow IMAP/SMTP access. Cerberus does not support Microsoft mailbox sign-in yet; password login is unavailable.

label: Yahoo Mail
help: Use your full Yahoo account email and a generated app password.

label: Fastmail
help: Use your full Fastmail account username and an app password with Mail access. Basic plans do not include IMAP/SMTP.

label: Zoho Mail (personal)
help: Defaults use Zoho’s .com data center. Confirm your region-specific servers in your account’s Server Configuration Details and enable IMAP. Use an app password with 2FA.

label: Zoho Mail (paid organization)
help: Defaults use Zoho’s .com paid-organization servers. Confirm your region-specific servers in your account’s Server Configuration Details and enable IMAP. Use an app password with 2FA.

label: Purelymail
help: Use your full mailbox username. If 2FA is enabled, generate an app password.

label: Proton Mail Bridge
help: Run Proton Mail Bridge on this computer (paid plan). Match the username, password, ports and security shown by Bridge; its defaults are filled below. Add Bridge’s trusted certificate PEM if needed. Your Proton account password will not work here.
